#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""DESeq2 differential expression: ASXL1 vs Control, controlling for sex, with apeglm LFC shrinkage."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read the count matrix (space-delimited featureCounts output)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_raw = pd.read_csv(
    "inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt",
    sep=r"\s+",
    comment="#",
)
print(f"Count matrix raw shape: {counts_raw.shape}")
print(f"Count matrix columns: {list(counts_raw.columns)}")

# Set gene ID as index
counts_raw = counts_raw.set_index("Geneid")
print(f"Count matrix after setting index, shape: {counts_raw.shape}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read coldata (sample metadata)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
coldata_raw = pd.read_excel(
    "inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx",
)
# Drop fully empty rows and columns
coldata_raw = coldata_raw.dropna(how="all").dropna(axis=1, how="all")
# Rename first column to 'sample'
coldata_raw.columns = ["sample", "condition", "sex", "age", "SIRE", "Hispanic"]
coldata_raw = coldata_raw.set_index("sample")
print(f"\nColdata shape: {coldata_raw.shape}")
print(coldata_raw)
print(f"\nCondition counts:\n{coldata_raw['condition'].value_counts()}")
print(f"\nSex counts:\n{coldata_raw['sex'].value_counts()}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Align counts and metadata — keep only samples present in both
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
common_samples = sorted(set(counts_raw.columns) & set(coldata_raw.index))
print(f"\nCommon samples ({len(common_samples)}): {common_samples}")

# Report samples in counts but not in coldata
counts_only = set(counts_raw.columns) - set(coldata_raw.index)
coldata_only = set(coldata_raw.index) - set(counts_raw.columns)
print(f"Samples in counts only (will be dropped): {counts_only}")
print(f"Samples in coldata only (will be dropped): {coldata_only}")

counts = counts_raw[common_samples].copy()
coldata = coldata_raw.loc[common_samples].copy()

print(f"\nFinal counts shape: {counts.shape}")
print(f"Final coldata shape: {coldata.shape}")

# Ensure counts are integers
counts = counts.astype(int)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare metadata for DESeq2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# condition and sex should be categorical; Control is reference level
coldata["condition"] = pd.Categorical(coldata["condition"], categories=["Control", "ASXL1"])
coldata["sex"] = pd.Categorical(coldata["sex"])

print(f"\nColdata dtypes:\n{coldata.dtypes}")
print(f"\nCondition categories: {coldata['condition'].cat.categories}")
print(f"Sex categories: {coldata['sex'].cat.categories}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run DESeq2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Running DESeq2 ===")
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts,
    metadata=coldata,
    design="~ sex + condition",
    design_factors=["condition", "sex"],
    ref_level=["condition", "Control"],
    n_cpus=1,
)
dds.deseq2()
print("DESeq2 fitting complete.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Extract results for ASXL1 vs Control
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Computing results (ASXL1 vs Control) ===")
stat_res = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["condition", "ASXL1", "Control"],
    alpha=0.05,
    n_cpus=1,
)
stat_res.summary()
print(f"Results shape before shrinkage: {stat_res.results_df.shape}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Apply apeglm LFC shrinkage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n=== Applying apeglm LFC shrinkage ===")
# The coefficient name follows the format: factor_level_vs_reference
stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_ASXL1_vs_Control")

results = stat_res.results_df
print(f"Results shape after shrinkage: {results.shape}")
print(f"\nResults columns: {list(results.columns)}")
print(f"\nFirst 10 rows of results:\n{results.head(10)}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Count significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove NA padj values (genes excluded by independent filtering)
results_valid = results.dropna(subset=["padj"])
print(f"\nGenes with non-NA padj: {len(results_valid)}")

sig_genes = results_valid[results_valid["padj"] < 0.05]
print(f"Significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05): {len(sig_genes)}")

# Also report the breakdown
print(f"\npadj distribution (excluding NA):")
print(f"  padj < 0.01: {(results_valid['padj'] < 0.01).sum()}")
print(f"  padj < 0.05: {(results_valid['padj'] < 0.05).sum()}")
print(f"  padj < 0.10: {(results_valid['padj'] < 0.10).sum()}")
print(f"  Total non-NA padj: {len(results_valid)}")

# Write the answer
import os
os.makedirs("codex_output", exist_ok=True)
with open("codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(str(len(sig_genes)) + "\n")
print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {len(sig_genes)}")

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# DESeq2: ASXL1 mutation vs Control, controlling for sex, apeglm LFC shrinkage

library(DESeq2)
library(apeglm)
library(readxl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read count matrix (space-delimited featureCounts output)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_raw <- read.table(
  "inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
cat("Count matrix raw dimensions:", dim(counts_raw), "\n")
cat("Count matrix columns:", head(colnames(counts_raw)), "...\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read coldata
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
coldata_raw <- read_excel("inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx")
coldata_raw <- as.data.frame(coldata_raw)
# Remove empty rows and the extra NA column
coldata_raw <- coldata_raw[!is.na(coldata_raw[,1]), ]
coldata_raw <- coldata_raw[, 1:6]
colnames(coldata_raw) <- c("sample", "condition", "sex", "age", "SIRE", "Hispanic")
rownames(coldata_raw) <- coldata_raw$sample
cat("\nColdata dimensions:", dim(coldata_raw), "\n")
print(coldata_raw)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Align counts and metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts_raw), rownames(coldata_raw))
cat("\nCommon samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")

counts_only <- setdiff(colnames(counts_raw), rownames(coldata_raw))
coldata_only <- setdiff(rownames(coldata_raw), colnames(counts_raw))
cat("Dropped from counts (no metadata):", counts_only, "\n")
cat("Dropped from coldata (no counts):", coldata_only, "\n")

counts <- counts_raw[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata_raw[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nFinal counts dimensions:", dim(counts), "\n")
cat("Final coldata dimensions:", dim(coldata), "\n")

# Ensure counts are integers
counts <- round(as.matrix(counts))
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Set up factors
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
coldata$sex <- factor(coldata$sex)

cat("\nCondition levels:", levels(coldata$condition), "\n")
cat("Sex levels:", levels(coldata$sex), "\n")
cat("\nCondition table:\n")
print(table(coldata$condition))
cat("\nSex table:\n")
print(table(coldata$sex))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run DESeq2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== Running DESeq2 ===\n")
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ sex + condition
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
cat("DESeq2 fitting complete.\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Results for ASXL1 vs Control
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== Computing results (ASXL1 vs Control) ===\n")
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "ASXL1", "Control"), alpha = 0.05)
cat("Results dimensions:", dim(res), "\n")

# Summary before shrinkage
cat("\nSummary before shrinkage:\n")
print(summary(res))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Apply apeglm LFC shrinkage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== Applying apeglm LFC shrinkage ===\n")
# The coefficient name in DESeq2: condition_ASXL1_vs_Control
res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_ASXL1_vs_Control", type = "apeglm")
cat("Shrinkage complete.\n")

cat("\nSummary after shrinkage:\n")
print(summary(res_shrunk))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Count significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove NA padj values
res_shrunk_valid <- res_shrunk[!is.na(res_shrunk$padj), ]
cat("\nGenes with non-NA padj:", nrow(res_shrunk_valid), "\n")

sig_genes <- res_shrunk_valid[res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.05, ]
cat("Significantly DE genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_genes), "\n")

# Detailed breakdown
cat("\npadj distribution (excluding NA):\n")
cat("  padj < 0.01:", sum(res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  padj < 0.05:", sum(res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  padj < 0.10:", sum(res_shrunk_valid$padj < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Total non-NA padj:", nrow(res_shrunk_valid), "\n")

# Write answer
dir.create("codex_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(nrow(sig_genes)), "codex_output/answer.txt")
cat("\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt:", nrow(sig_genes), "\n")
